adjudication.rationale: In `app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb`, `def update` ignores any params/body and simply re-renders the current `@embedding` OpenStruct (set by `fetch_embedding`) via `render_serialized`, making PUT `/admin/customize/embedding` a silent no-op that always “succeeds”. The frontend also defines `saveChanges()` calling `this.get('embedding').update({});` (`admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6`), even though the template currently has no save button. This is diff-grounded as an incomplete/misleading endpoint rather than a proven runtime defect in the UI flow shown.
